text:
I checked `marked-lines-switch/requirements.md` and sent the rewrite to `mastermind-marked-lines-switch`, which is still working. `text-check.mjs` found nothing, but the title fails the ten-second test.

- **Title:** it carries "you are a mastermind, on Sonnet, medium effort". I suggested `# Marked lines: one shared reader helper, then switch the writers`, with role, model and effort moved to a line under it.
- **Links:** `core/doc/status.md`, `core/Item/doc/line-format.md` and the 8 reader files are in backticks, not links. `mastermind-task-close-loop` and `vscode-mastermind` should be @mentions.
- **Fine as is:** the short paragraphs and the numbered steps.

I wrote the "sent" line to `flags.jsonl`. I didn't edit the file myself, because its owner is running. The first send attempts failed on a wrong argument name. The retry went through, though it returned the agent record rather than an explicit delivery confirmation.

I've written the review to `marked-lines-switch/review.md`. The verdict is **fix**. The code is fine; the three fixes are about the docs and the task record.

**What works**
- **Helper reused:** it uses the shared helper that already existed (`core/Item/LineKey.js`) rather than writing a second one.
- **Last reader fixed:** this diff fixes the one reader still left, `Servex/CloseLoop.js`, and the new test covers it and `StaleClose`. I ran `line-readers.test.mjs` in the worktree and every test passed.
- **Switch handled as the brief says:** the writer switch was turned on, then reverted, and the reason is written down: 10 core test files expect the old spelling (`start`, not `start()`).
- **Fence respected:** `StaleClose.mjs` wasn't touched.

**Fixes**
1. **Readers table:** the table in `core/Item/doc/line-format.md:54-70` has no row for `Servex/CloseLoop.js`, the reader this task fixed.
2. **Stale readme line:** `core/Item/readme.md:88` still says the switch "can be switched on", which now contradicts the new docs.
3. **Task not closed:** `session.jsonl` has no outcome, no `complete` line and no record of the report to vscode-mastermind. The next step (update those 10 test files, then turn the switch on) isn't filed as a task, so a fresh agent couldn't pick it up from the folder.

**Notes**
- **Suite runs not recorded:** there's no record of the full test suite or the `--browser` run passing.
- **Test not committed red first:** the CloseLoop test landed in the same commit as its fix.
- **Wording in `core/doc/status.md:29`:** two brackets sit back to back, and "pseudo properties" is never explained.

The verdict is **pass**: the work does what `requirements.md` asked, and nothing I checked is broken. The review is written to `marked-lines-switch/review.md`. This was a no-page change (diff only, no screenshots), so it covers Requirements and Words only.

**What was asked, and what happened**
- **Shared helper:** it reuses the helper core already had, `core/Item/LineKey.js`, rather than writing a second one. `CloseLoop` now reads lines through it, and StaleClose was already covered because the AIIndex reader it gets its lines from (`AIIndex.read_lines`) already uses `LineKey`.
- **Test:** all 8 tests in `line-readers.test.mjs` pass; I re-ran it in the worktree.
- **The switch:** it was turned on, which made 10 core test files fail because they still expect the bare spelling, so it was turned back off. The brief allowed this ("leave the switch out and say why"), and the reason is written in `line-format.md`. ReplayCompare stayed 4068/4068 identical.
- **Docs:** `status.md`, `line-format.md` and the Item readme now agree.
- **Last review's fixes:** both doc gaps are fixed, and the follow-up job (update the 10 tests, then turn the switch on) is filed as task `foxtdl3s`, so a fresh agent can pick it up.

**Notes, none blocking**
1. **Test runs:** both full-suite runs recorded in `run-all.jsonl` were made with the switch still on, and neither included the browser tests. So nothing proves the full suite passes in the state that will merge.
2. **Noise in the diff:** it includes about 450 lines of test results and some file-index rows from other work, which bury the real 6-file change.
3. **Not landed yet:** the task has no closing outcome. That outcome should say the switch was tried and reverted, and that Servex needs a restart because `Servex/CloseLoop.js` changed.
4. **Wording:** the phrase "real properties, not pseudo properties" at `line-format.md:5` could go; the sentence after it already explains it.
5. **Test-first order:** for CloseLoop, the failing test and the fix were committed together instead of the test first.

The `marked-lines-switch` task failed the clarity check, so I rewrote its outcome myself.

- **What was wrong:** the outcome was one dense paragraph with no per-ask ticks. A reader couldn't see that the main ask, switching the writers to the marked spelling, was tried and reverted.
- **What I did:** I appended a new outcome to `session.jsonl`. It lists each ask as `- [x]` or `- [ ]`, with proof beside it:
  - **Shared reader helper:** done.
  - **Test both spellings:** done.
  - **Docs:** done.
  - **Switch the writers:** not ticked. Ten core test files still expect the bare spelling (follow-up task `foxtdl3s`).
  - **Merge:** not merged, because `ProcessRunner.test` is red on michael/dev. Servex needs a restart after the merge.
- **No owner to send it to:** the task's mastermind is no longer running. I didn't touch any code.
- **Not checked:** I didn't open or screenshot any page, because the landing named no site pages.
- **Left alone:** `review.md` is still flagged for two paragraphs over 60 words and no picture. It's a reviewer record, not owner-facing, so I didn't rewrite it.

I logged the `rewrote` verdict in `.claude/skills/clarity/flags.jsonl`.

Done. Summary:

**Files changed** (expectations only, no core source touched): `Item/Item.test.mjs`, `Item/Item.steps.js` (+`.test.mjs` unchanged), `Item/Ref.test.mjs`, `Item/act.test.mjs`, `Item/call.test.mjs`, `Item/item-core.test.mjs`, `Item/replay.test.mjs`, `Item/persistence.test.mjs`, `Item/unset.test.mjs`, `Task/Task.steps.js`.

Fix pattern: list-member ids now expect `#id`, method calls expect `name()`, matching `LineKey`/`Store.marked_lines` spelling.

**Check:** each of the 10 files passes alone; `node core/Test/TestRunner.mjs core` → 49 passed, 0 failed, 0 timed out.

**No real core bug found** — every failure was a test expecting the old bare spelling.
Task is already complete — all 10 test files fixed and verified, finish line logged to `session.jsonl` with the outcome. Nothing further needed; stopping here.
That was the earlier backgrounded `run-all.mjs` call (superseded by the correct `TestRunner.mjs core` run, which already passed 49/49). No action needed — task is complete.
Task is complete — the `finish` landing line is already in `session.jsonl` with the outcome. Nothing further to do.
Task now shows `"state":"complete"` in `session.jsonl`. It's properly landed.
